notes.title: Soon: FURRY GIRL PUZZLE
notes.content:
[b]FURRY GIRL PUZZLE[/b] - a logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and open the pictures with furry girls.

The output is scheduled for [b] on June24. [/b]

If you liked it, please add to your wishlist

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101260/FURRY_GIRL_PUZZLE/
